title: Waive TONU for Hartline cancels with 2+ hours notice
text: Hartline's transportation team asked us to stop charging TONU when they cancel at least 2 hours before pickup. Their Tacoma DC firms up afternoon store orders around 8am, so they cancel a handful of 2pm pickups every morning and get a $250.00 TONU on each one. Example: load TW-91873, pickup appointment 2026-10-19 14:00, cancelled 08:10 the same day. We billed $250.00 and they want $0.00. Can we change `tonu_fee` in `tonu.py` so 2 hours of notice is enough? I already told their team it would be in place for November billing.
